data.description:
Not a shop so much as a counter beside the door, where the faithful leave coin and take away what the temple can spare. Healing draughts, holy water, a symbol to carry.

Spellcasting here draws on the divine lists. How much the temple will part with in a day is finite: roll 1d4+1 slots in a village, 1d8+1 in a town, 1d12+1 in a city.
